PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB GDDR7 Verto Dual Fan Graphics Card

Empower your heavy creative rendering, AI processing, and ultra-settings gaming with the high-performance PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB GDDR7 Verto Dual Fan graphics card, distributed via Turbo Computer Egypt. Built on NVIDIA's high-efficiency next-generation architecture, this standout model features a massive 16GB of ultra-fast next-gen GDDR7 dedicated memory layout combined with cutting-edge PCIe 5.0 high-speed interface support, providing an expansive, bottleneck-free frame buffer. The specialized Verto Dual Fan configuration integrates a streamlined thermal setup with a dedicated Stealth Mode for whisper-quiet or silent operational capability under varied workloads. Complete with a compact multi-slot footprint for excellent case compatibility, this elite graphics infrastructure is officially backed by a 3-year factory warranty.
